clean_apply.method: the generated patch reverse-applies cleanly to the current overlay on the pinned base, proving the overlay bytes are exactly the patch result

corpus_qualification: this milestone is a source-confirmed integration gap plus generated relocation-complete execution fixture; it makes no claim that R_ARM_GOT_PREL is frequent in the retained firmware corpus

fixed_static_got_contract.default_policy: reject atomically with no candidate and require --firmbolt-arm-got=fixed-static
fixed_static_got_contract.handler: BOLT recognizes, sizes, extracts, range-checks and encodes R_ARM_GOT_PREL, retains the logical target identity, and binds the JITLink edge to the exact retained firmware GOT slot instead of synthesizing a hosted GOT

absolute_literal_address.diagnostic: changed the observable address from 0x8000134 to 0x800010c

fixed_static_got_contract.policy: exact retained non-executable file-backed GOT slot, unique exact target word, no interpreter and no dynamic relocation
fixed_static_got_contract.transformation: whole-image ordering moves got_worker from 0x08000128 to 0x08000100 and its owned relocation from 0x08000134 to 0x0800010c while retaining the fixed RAM slot, target identity, mapping transitions, exact origins and execution result

scope_limits: the qualified policy covers an exact section named .got with one uniquely matching retained slot; additional firmware schemas require explicit typed metadata
dynamic GOT and PLT construction, runtime relocation, symbol interposition and Linux loader behavior remain unsupported
GOT-relative R_ARM_TARGET2 remains unsupported even though exact R_ARM_GOT_PREL is now qualified
the literal-address negative proves atomic rejection of one changed observable placement; it is not whole-firmware semantic equivalence
the production matrix demonstrates no regression across the existing firmware corpus, not complete x86-backend parity
the milestone establishes reference-graph, relocation, publication and architectural-execution correctness, not a performance result

source.aaelf32: R_ARM_GOT_PREL computes G(S)+A-P and identifies the target symbol independently from the GOT slot
source.pinned_bolt_gap: the ARM relocation handler and expression path did not recognize type 96, and generic JITLink GOT-request handling would synthesize linker-owned state rather than bind the fixed firmware slot
source.policy_boundary: FirmBOLT implements only an explicit fixed-static firmware graph and rejects unqualified or dynamic interpretations
